name: stock-intelligence-system
description: Multi-agent AI stock intelligence platform — root convenience scripts. Real code lives in backend/ and frontend/.

scripts.db: docker compose exec postgres psql -U stockai -d stockai
scripts.prisma:push: docker compose exec backend npx prisma db push
scripts.prisma:studio: docker compose exec backend npx prisma studio
scripts.sync:stocks: docker compose exec backend npm run sync:stocks
scripts.test: docker compose exec backend npm test
scripts.typecheck: docker compose exec backend npx tsc --noEmit && docker compose exec frontend npx tsc --noEmit
